fixed: The diver's line stood nearly empty blue for about three seconds: the camera was above the reef and the diver tiny. It looks down on the reef now, the diver dives from beside the houseboats to the corals, and a few fish are always about.
The sand under the village looked like a dry beach; it is seen through the water now.
The bigger tank in the Bajau grown-up was a small gold mark on an orange shirt; it is larger, outlined, glowing, and pops in on its word.
+50% came only after the tennis ball: the line is cut in two, the number landing on 'fifty' and the camera pulling back to the tennis ball on its own word.
notes: Through the water from the seal up to the Bajau village on stilts (THE BAJAU / SEA NOMADS), the houseboats sailing in; a family on its platform, a gold tank glowing in the grown-up; a diver diving to the reef among fish; the scan on the shore, the two spleens arriving on their names, +50%, a tennis ball beside the screen; into the Bajau spleen to a turning strand of DNA, one piece glowing (IN THEIR GENES); out to the houseboats, 1,000 YEARS, days and nights flickering past. Measured: never empty for more than 0.4 s, never still.
